name: extension-duplicate-check
description: GitHub Action that flags new Raycast extensions that look like duplicates of store extensions or other open pull requests

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
